Class SwingStoreView

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.view.swing.SwingStoreView
All Implemented Interfaces:
BaseView, CartView, CustomerView, EmployeeView, MainView, ProductView, TransactionView
public class SwingStoreView extends Object implements MainView, ProductView, CustomerView, CartView, TransactionView, EmployeeView
Main Swing-based GUI implementation of the StoreView interface. Provides a comprehensive graphical user interface for the store management system using Java Swing components with card-based navigation. Features include: - Multi-panel card layout navigation - User authentication (customer/employee) - Integrated view for all store operations - Exception handling and user feedback - Responsive UI with proper threading

    • getCategoryInput

      public CategoryDTO getCategoryInput()
      Prompts the user to select a product category from available options. This method should present all available product categories to the user and return the selected category as a DTO. The implementation should handle user cancellation gracefully, typically by returning a default category. Displays a selection dialog with all available product categories using JOptionPane. The categories are presented using their display names for user-friendly selection. If the user cancels the dialog or an error occurs, this method returns the first available category as a default.
      Specified by:
      getCategoryInput in interface ProductView
      Returns:
      the selected CategoryDTO, or the first category if cancelled/error

    • getSubcategoryInput

      public SubcategoryDTO getSubcategoryInput(CategoryDTO category)
      Prompts the user to select a product subcategory based on the selected category. This method presents only the subcategories that belong to the specified parent category. The implementation should filter subcategories appropriately and allow the user to select from the filtered list. Displays a selection dialog with subcategories filtered by the specified parent category. If the category has no subcategories, returns null. The subcategories are presented using their display names for user-friendly selection via JOptionPane.
      Specified by:
      getSubcategoryInput in interface ProductView
      Parameters:
      category - the parent CategoryDTO to filter subcategories by
      Returns:
      the selected SubcategoryDTO, or null if no subcategories available or user cancels
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if category is null
